title: Travel Completed, UK regime applies (UK departure), APPR also applies, Most Generous = EU/UK, Controllable (Code 65, flight deck crew special request), delay 4+ hrs, Cash (Interac) selected, 3 pax, 1 leg, Basic Aeroplan linked, no changes
description:
An end-to-end eligible claim for a 3-passenger booking on a UK departure. AC 865 LHR ? YUL arrived 5 hours late because of a controllable reason (Code 65, a flight deck crew special request that wasn't operationally required). The UK regime (EU 261 UK branch) applies because the trip starts in the UK. APPR also applies because the flight lands in Canada. Most-generous logic picks EU/UK. Compensation is GBP 520 per passenger (DELAY_GTE_4_HOURS): GBP 1,560 cash, or GBP 1,872 AC Wallet with the 20% top-up. The customer lives in Canada and picks Cash, so payment goes by Interac in CAD and only the email is collected. Also checks the EU eligible DDS response, the UK 6-year limit, CyberSource GREEN, Persona PASS, and that the Claims Dashboard shows all 3 passengers with EU/UK selected.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC079: 3 passengers. Catherine Bouchard (Adult, claimant, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing), Alexandre Bouchard (Adult), Sophie Bouchard (Child, paid fare, not an infant). One AC international leg: AC 865 LHR ? YUL, January 15, 2026. Departure country: United Kingdom. Scheduled arrival 14:00, actual 19:00 (5h, 300 min). Cancellation code: NONE. Arrival delay code: 65 (FR, flight deck crew special request, controllable), so Fallback = FALSE. Status: Arrived (operated). Delay announced less than 14 days before departure (day-of-travel). No VOL or INVOL changes. AC only. Filed January 28, 2026 (D+13, more than 72 hours after arrival, within the 2190-day UK limit). No duplicate. Not employees. CyberSource set to GREEN. Persona set to IDV PASS. Country of residence: Canada (CAD, Interac, email only).
